text:
If you’re heading out for sunset, you’ll have a clear view through 5:56, though the north wind may still be gusty around Burlington this evening before easing. Skies stay mostly clear tonight, with temperatures falling to around 34 and a north wind at 7 to 14 mph, so it’ll feel colder once the sun is gone.

Friday looks like the easy one, sunny from start to finish with a high near 54 and a lighter north wind around 9 mph. Another clear, chilly night follows, with temperatures dipping to around 30. Enjoy the sunset, but grab the warmer layer for the walk home.
